items.source_sentence: Brent crude futures briefly gave back some of their gains.
items.japanese_gloss: 上がった分をいったん吐き出す

items.source_sentence: Reuters linked that rise to concern about a US sea blockade of Iran, planned for the next day, and energy shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.
For the moment, only a large number stood at center stage.
Then the story took a sharp turn.
The aim was to recover the cost of US efforts to keep the strait safe.
items.japanese_gloss: かかった費用を回収する
